title: T4OffLC anchor landed: the 058e per-point witness-run margin is now EXACT Lean pins (C = 5001, sigma-cancel exact, C > 5000 threshold sharp, whole-band closure, mass <= 1001/30006000000, tPT2 pin) - off-board positive-dual margin record, no RH claim
content: NEW MODULE formal/RhAttack/T4OffLC.lean (326 lines, 8 theorems + wC + witnessTerm), full tree green at 17454 jobs, zero linter warnings in the module. It freezes the 058e per-point witness-run measurement (scripts/rh/day058e_tuned_schedule.py) as EXACT RATIONAL PINS against the in-tree floor lemma S4O.hMownScaleLo - the WheelTile anchor pattern (measure first, Lean after): (1) def wC : Q := 5001 (smallest integer certificate with 2e-4 margin) and witnessTerm t = (1/(2*wC)) * t^-2, the first T4 term of the per-point 0123-family run after EXACT sigma cancellation (t4LC_schedTerm: (1/2)*n^-sigma = (1/2)*C^-1*t^-2 EXACTLY for n = C^(1/sigma)*t^(2/sigma), sigma = 1/2 - d0); (2) t4LC_thresh: (1/(2*wC))*(1+t^-2)^2 < 1/10000 for t >= 1000, i.e. the edge requirement C > 5000 SHARP (the in-tree 0123 uniform constant 9999/2 = 4999.5 is 1.0001e-4 OVER it); (3) t4LC_floorLo: restate of S4O.hMownScaleLo with band-edge skeleton (1/10000)(200*d)^2*t^-2*(1+t^-2)^-2 <= mown t d - the margin GROWS off the edge like (200*d)^2; (4) t4LC_bandClosure: witnessTerm t < S4O.mown t d for the WHOLE band d in [1/200, 1/2] and ALL t >= 1000 (strict, uniform in d, t-independence exact to (1+10^-6)^2); (5) t4LC_ratioPin: (10000/10002)*(1+t^-2)^2 <= 9999/10000 - the measured 2e-4 edge margin as a theorem; (6) t4LC_massRel: the EM-tail mass relative to the witness term is <= 1001/30006000000 (= 3.34e-8, ~0.02% of the edge margin) on the whole band t >= 1000, 0 < sigma <= 1/2 (via n^(1/2) = wC^(1/(2sigma)) * t^(1/sigma) >= wC*t^2); (7) t4LC_massGap: the MASS-AUGMENTED ratio pin (10000/10002)*(1+10^-6)^2*(1+1001/30006000000) < 9999/10000 (norm_num) - the mass cannot close the edge-margin gap; (8) t4LC_bandClosure_PT2: the explicit terminal-frontier pin witnessTerm WinC.tPT2 < S4O.mown WinC.tPT2 d for every in-band d. STATUS per 0249: OFF-BOARD POSITIVE-DUAL MARGIN RECORD in the family of 0244-0247 + T4OffLB - machine-verified, explicit, NOT load-bearing for the endpoint, keeping the per-point-run squeeze variant warm with an exact C-threshold (5000) and an explicit C = 5001 certificate. The uniform n4 wire had no such t-independence (island died at t* = 9.698e14, 0247); the per-point run has no t*. LEAN 4.33.1 TACTIC LESSON (recorded for future rpow work): UNANNOTATED LITERAL-ONLY real exponents such as '(1 / 2)' in an rpow position are elaborated as NAT division (value 0!) - e.g. (x ^ (1/2)) silently becomes (x ^ 0 = 1) - which made rw 'pattern not found' on every real-power pattern in the module; the fix is always annotating the exponent '(1 / 2 : Real)'. Also: rw on Real.rpow_mul / Real.mul_rpow needs the hypotheses explicitly supplied with closed types (e.g. 'by norm_num [wC] : 0 <= (wC : Real)'); bare 'rw [rpow_mul]' leaves 0 <= ?x subgoals, and passing an anonymous 'by linarith' for hx can mis-infer the implicit base. HONESTY: no RH claim - no zeta evaluation, no zero-existence statement; this is bound-level machine wire-vs-floor arithmetic only.
